tooltip.olru.legacy_prime.style: Aggressive mobility, burst damage, and aerial finishers
tooltip.olru.legacy_of_horus.style: Support control through healing, extraction, sedation, and team buffs
tooltip.olru.final_answer.style: Sustain support through life drain, biotic energy, and a decisive healing beam
Fires a precise hitscan blast. A connected shot deals direct Hand Cannon damage.
tooltip.olru.legacy_prime.skill_one.mech: Release to surge forward. Colliding with a target hammers and launches it; later wall impact uses separate impact damage.
tooltip.olru.legacy_prime.skill_two.mech: Launches you upward and strikes enemies in front. Hit targets rise with a short upward inertia.
tooltip.olru.legacy_prime.skill_three.me: Leap forward in an arc, then slam the ground. Enemies in the forward shock zone take damage and are slowed.
tooltip.olru.legacy_prime.ultimate.mecha: Teleports you above the fight, lets you hover and aim, then slams down in a marked impact zone.
tooltip.olru.legacy_prime.ultimate.info: %s%% charge per dmg · hover %ss · radius %sb/%sb · outer dmg %s-%s
tooltip.olru.legacy_of_horus.normal_atta: Fires a light biotic shot. Allies are healed; hostile targets take modest impact damage.
tooltip.olru.legacy_of_horus.skill_one.m: While held, pulls allies in your forward cone toward you. On release, heals and protects them, or dashes you if no ally is locked.
tooltip.olru.legacy_of_horus.skill_two.m: Fires a dart that disrupts hostile targets, suppresses normal creature behavior, and drags airborne targets downward.
tooltip.olru.legacy_of_horus.skill_three: Throw a gravity-affected biotic grenade. It detonates on contact, healing allies and damaging enemies in the splash.
tooltip.olru.legacy_of_horus.ultimate.me: Empowers nearby allies with healing, damage, resistance, stronger incoming healing, and emergency aid for critically wounded targets.
While held, sprays biotic energy in a forward cone, healing allies (not yourself) and leaving lingering regeneration.
tooltip.olru.final_answer.skill_one.mech: Hold to drain the nearest enemy in a forward cone, restoring your health and biotic energy.
tooltip.olru.final_answer.skill_one.info: no CD · cone %sb/%s° · dmg %s · self-heal %s · energy +%s/hit
tooltip.olru.final_answer.skill_two.mech: Vanish briefly: extreme speed, jump boost, invisibility, and invulnerability, keeping your momentum on exit.
tooltip.olru.final_answer.skill_three.me: Hurls a slow biotic orb that pulses damage onto nearby enemies until its damage pool is spent.
tooltip.olru.final_answer.ultimate.mecha: Channels a long beam that heals allies, damages enemies, and restores your own health. Only Fade is usable while channeling.
